concept_name: The Golden Hoop Mantra as External Executive Control
english_name: Golden Hoop Mantra as External Executive Control
cognitive_definition: Executive control: the prefrontal cortex's ability to inhibit limbic-system impulses; when the emotional system (limbic system) is about to erupt, external intervention is needed to activate the prefrontal cortex.
core_case: When Wukong's emotional system (limbic system) is about to erupt, Tang Sanzang forcibly activates his prefrontal cortex through verbal stimulation (the Golden Hoop Mantra), making him suppress his impulses — the earliest case of 'external cognitive intervention'.

prefrontal_cortex.function: Rational decision-making · impulse inhibition · goal direction
prefrontal_cortex.wukong_equivalent: The pilgrimage goal · protecting Tang Sanzang · not taking life
prefrontal_cortex.activation_method: Stimulation by the Golden Hoop Mantra

limbic_system.wukong_equivalent: Anger · combativeness · the impulse to kill
limbic_system.trigger: Demon provocations · Tang Sanzang's misunderstandings · feeling wronged

amygdala.regulation: The Golden Hoop Mantra activates the prefrontal cortex to inhibit the amygdala

mantra_cases.context: First use · Wukong kills the Six Robbers
mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong kills; Tang Sanzang scolds him; Wukong wants to leave
mantra_cases.outcome: Wukong yields in pain and stays for the pilgrimage
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: First establishes the 'external executive control' mechanism

mantra_cases.context: Thrice Beats the White Bone Demon
mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong kills the White Bone Demon; Tang Sanzang disbelieves him
mantra_cases.outcome: Wukong is banished, but his prefrontal cortex has been activated
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: Executive control over-applied · drives Wukong away

mantra_cases.context: Rescuing the king of the Black Rooster Kingdom
mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong wants to strike the demon; Tang Sanzang cautions him
mantra_cases.outcome: Wukong restrains himself and switches to outwitting the enemy
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: Mild stimulation · activates the prefrontal cortex · switches to strategy

mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong is burned and wants to force a breakthrough
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: Executive control teaches Wukong to seek help

mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong kills; Tang Sanzang scolds him
mantra_cases.outcome: Wukong is banished; the Six-Eared Macaque episode ensues
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: Executive control over-applied · triggers an inner-demon eruption

mantra_cases.context: Rescuing the queen of the Zhu Zi Kingdom
mantra_cases.trigger_event: Wukong wants to kill the demon; Tang Sanzang cautions him
mantra_cases.outcome: Wukong restrains himself and switches to a stratagem
mantra_cases.cognitive_effect: Mild reminder · Wukong has internalized executive control

early_phase.characteristic: High intensity, frequent use · establishes the mechanism

late_phase.characteristic: Light use · Wukong has internalized executive control

executive_control_insights: The Golden Hoop Mantra is the earliest case of 'external cognitive intervention', akin to modern cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)
In the early phase the mantra is intense, establishing the executive-control mechanism
In the middle phase the mantra's intensity drops; Wukong begins to internalize executive control
In the late phase the mantra is hardly used; Wukong has fully internalized it
This is a classic case of cognitive development: from external control to internalized control

modern_parallel.cbt: Cognitive behavioral therapy · changes behavior patterns through verbal intervention
modern_parallel.neurofeedback: Neurofeedback training · trains the brain to self-regulate through external signals
modern_parallel.meditation: Meditation training · activates the prefrontal cortex · inhibits the amygdala
modern_parallel.wukong_case: The Golden Hoop Mantra = the earliest hybrid of CBT + neurofeedback + meditation training
